_about: ILCA class layer for the flags library (ILCA 4, ILCA 6, ILCA 7). It never changes an RRS meaning. Same format as optimist.json. Sources: ILCA Class Rules 2026 (valid from 2023-08-21): no rule changes RRS 42 and no personal flotation device rule; EurILCA 'RRS 42 Guide ILCA 4, 6 & 7' (March 2022): 'ILCA class rules affecting RRS 42: None'; 2025 ILCA 6 Women's & ILCA 7 Men's Worlds NoR (Appendix P, PFD at all times afloat, yellow/blue/red fleet colours, trapezoid course); ILCA SIs: 2024 Oceania & Australian Masters, 2022 US Open (San Diego), 2022 ILCA Atlantic Coast Championships (Larchmont), 2025 ILCA Sprint Series (Dublin). See .claude/memory/flags-sources.md.
